Action:
1. Drag the ◀▶ knob to about 01:50
2. Let go and note the bubble's time
3. Start a screen recording
4. Tap play under the Preview
5. Leave the screen untouched for 30 s (playback reaches the right handle at 02:00 after about 10 s)
6. Stop the recording
7. Tap the button under the Preview once more
Expected Result:
Step 4: playback starts from the time noted in step 2, and the playhead, the bubble and the Preview time advance together up to the right handle (02:00)
Step 5: what playback does on reaching the right handle is recorded: it stops there, it jumps back (to the selection start 00:30 or to the time noted in step 2) or it plays on past 02:00
Step 5: after a jump back, whether it plays again by itself (a loop) or waits paused is recorded
Step 5: where the playhead and its bubble rest 20 s after the handle was reached is recorded
Step 5: the Preview time and the burned-in time of the frame shown at that moment are recorded
Step 5: the state of the button under the Preview at that moment (play or pause icon) is recorded
Step 7: what the tap does is recorded (it plays or pauses) and, when it plays, the time it starts from
Steps 1–7: both trim handles stay at 00:30 and 02:00
Steps 1–7: 「Selected Length」 stays 「01:30」
No source states what play does at the end of the selection (Q-28), so whichever outcome is seen the row is recorded as Fail (question) for PM with what was recorded, never as a Pass
Actual: Play stops at the right trim handle and the next play restarts from the selection start 00:30, a behaviour no source states (Q-28, for PM). Step 1–2 (knob dragged): bubble and Preview time 「01:50」, burned-in 00:01:50.1 (frame 3303). Step 4: play starts at 01:50; the button shows ‖ while playing; Preview time, bubble and playhead advance together second by second 01:50 → 02:00 (recording TC-350-play, 1 fps samples), reaching the handle about 11 s after the tap. Step 5: at the right handle playback stops by itself on 「02:01/12:30」 (burned-in 00:02:01.3, frame 3639, i.e. at the handle's x.y-second position, KF-011), no jump back, no loop, does not play past the handle; the button turns back to ▶; 20 s later playhead and bubble still rest at the handle reading 「02:01」, Preview 「02:01/12:30」, ▶ shown. Step 7: one tap on ▶ plays again from the selection start 「00:30」 (not from 01:50 where play began, not from the handle) and runs on (00:30 → 00:37 in 7 s); paused again at 00:45. Steps 1–7: trim handles stayed at 00:30 / 02:00 and 「Selected Length」 stayed 「01:30」 throughout.
